statement:
∀ (a b : ℝ),
  a + 2 < b →
    ∀ (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1)) (hy : y ∈ Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1)),
      Relation.EqvGen (fun p q => |↑p - ↑q| < 1) ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ ↔ (x < a + 1 ↔ y < a + 1)

# name: set-closeness-pieces-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.closeness_two_pieces
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['0', '5', '(by norm_num)', '1/2', '11/2', '(Or.inl (by norm_num))', '(Or.inr (by norm_num))'], True, 'set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
have key : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a + 2 < b) (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1)) (hy : y ∈ Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1)), Relation.EqvGen (fun p q : ↥(Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1)) => |(p : ℝ) - (q : ℝ)| < 1) ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ ↔ (x < a + 1 ↔ y < a + 1) := by
  intro a b hab x y hx hy
  have key : ∀ p q : ↥(Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1)),
      Relation.EqvGen (fun p q : ↥(Set.Ioo a (a + 1) ∪ Set.Ioo b (b + 1)) => |(p : ℝ) - (q : ℝ)| < 1) p q →
        ((p : ℝ) < a + 1 ↔ (q : ℝ) < a + 1) := by
    intro p q hpq
    induction hpq with
    | rel p q hpq =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := p
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := q
      simp only at hpq ⊢
      rw [abs_lt] at hpq
      rcases hp with hp | hp <;> rcases hq with hq | hq <;>
        simp only [Set.mem_Ioo] at hp hq <;> constructor <;> intro <;> linarith
    | refl => exact Iff.rfl
    | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
    | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact key _ _ h
  · intro h
    apply Relation.EqvGen.rel
    simp only
    rw [abs_lt]
    rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rcases hy with hy | hy <;> simp only [Set.mem_Ioo] at hx hy
    · constructor <;> linarith
    · exact absurd (h.1 hx.2) (by linarith)
    · exact absurd (h.2 hy.2) (by linarith)
    · constructor <;> linarith
